name: oma
description: A full SDLC team in one plugin: PM, Architect, UX, Frontend, Backend, QA, Security, DevOps, SEO, Marketing and Social agents that take a project idea through phase-gated discovery, architecture, design, build, QA and launch — coordinated through durable on-disk state, with you approving every gate — or unattended overnight with /oma:auto, which front-loads the questions, approves each gate against an objective checklist, halts rather than guessing, and leaves you a report of every assumption it made. Built and validated for Next.js + TypeScript + Prisma; other stacks are supported by design but unproven.
